name: OrgLab MDM Baseline v1.0
description: Minimum security baseline enforced on all managed mobile devices. Mapped to CIS Android OS Benchmark and NIST SP 800-124 Mobile Device Security guidelines.
author: Sulemana Akuantu Abdul Jalil
references: CIS Android OS Benchmark v3.x - 4.x Device Access Control
NIST SP 800-124 Rev 2 Guidelines for Managing the Security of Mobile Devices in the Enterprise
OWASP MASTG - Mobile App Security Testing Guide

rules.title: Screen lock is configured
rules.expected: A PIN, password or pattern is set (password_type != 0)

rules.title: Auto-lock timeout <= 60 seconds
rules.remediation: adb shell settings put system screen_off_timeout 30000

rules.title: Device storage is encrypted
rules.remediation: Enforce via device admin 'require encryption' policy

rules.title: USB debugging is disabled
rules.remediation: adb shell settings put global adb_enabled 0

rules.title: Installation from unknown sources is blocked
rules.remediation: adb shell settings put secure install_non_market_apps 0

rules.title: App verification (Play Protect) is enabled
rules.remediation: adb shell settings put global package_verifier_enable 1

rules.title: Android security patch is current
rules.remediation: Apply OTA / update image in lab
